bayts.text: I praise my Lord for (the gift of) Muḥammad: upon him the best of the blessings of the Everlasting Refuge (Aṣ-Ṣamad).
Bless, O Allah, my life, and make my heart the dwelling-place of the Verses (of the Qur'an).
You have made me free, O Lord, of associating (others with You): make lasting in me the certainty endowed with discernment.
To You alone I have turned my need, forever: so enrich me, and make my sufficiency everlasting.
I have addressed my intimate prayer to a generous and kind Bestower (Al-Wahhāb), who with goodness leads me to the Gardens of Paradise.
I have addressed my intimate prayer to the Everlasting, the Ancient (Allah), who sent down His Book and leads me to the abode of hospitality (Paradise).
He leads me to my entering the Gardens, and in the Gardens is that which delights the heart.
To Him my words are addressed, well pleased with Him and with His Messenger (Muḥammad); and whoever hated me has found no help.
You have given me possession of the Book (the Qur'an): so preserve it in me, and by it preserve my life, O my Lord.
Let Your Book be with me wherever I may be, O You in whom, through it, O my God, I place my reliance.
It is You who have led to me the authentic copies of the Qur'an (aṣ-ṣiḥāʿ); for me and in my favour You have led certainty and soundness.
You have banished forever my need of any other than You, O Best of those who enrich, You who are worshipped in want.
You have adorned Your Remembrance (adh-dhikr) with my life, just as through it You have adorned me, loving and made steadfast.
You taught me, O my Sovereign, the words (of the Qur'an), and through me You raise up Your company, those who preserve it by heart (al-ḥuffāẓ).
The measured recitation (at-tartīl) of the verses of the Book keeps one from adversities, by the grace of the Enricher (Al-Mughnī).
Truly, the recitation of the Book has turned the enemies towards other than my harm, and they have turned away.
No evil turns towards my life, through my Lord's safekeeping, nor any evildoer.
The Book leads to me that which gladdens, without end, and I am not beguiled by illusion.
My life gladdens the Messenger of God (Muḥammad): upon him the salutations of peace of the One who humbles the heedless (al-lāhī).
The Lord of the worlds has given me possession of the Qur'an, and the Trustworthy (Gabriel) and the Trustworthy (Muḥammad) have led it to me.
The Bestower of benefit (An-Nāfiʿ) has benefited me with a benefit beyond all measure, and has led to me honour and concord.
Service to the best of the worlds (Muḥammad) has seized for me the wondrous graces (al-karāmāt), all together, and they have been seized.
The letter "Jīm" (ج) leads me as the noble are led, while the Stoned One (Satan) has turned elsewhere, towards others.
God and the Messenger (Muḥammad) have been well pleased with me, and so have the people of Badr; and what I asked has come to me.
My life has attained triumph through the Permanence of God, through the Book and through the Messenger of God (Muḥammad).
My heart is a trust committed to my Lord, and so is the tongue together with the limbs; and I have triumphed with the beautiful (rewards).
He (Allah) who has shielded me from every harm leads me, under His protection, to Paradise.
I praise my Lord for (the gift of) Muḥammad: how excellent is my means with my Lord, the Everlasting Refuge (Aṣ-Ṣamad)!
